tables.title: Traffic-sign recognition: ablation (GTSRB official test)
tables.note: Corruption column: mean over 9 road-scene corruptions x 3 severities (noise, motion blur, defocus, fog, rain, low light, glare, occlusion, JPEG).

tables.title: Road-surface condition (RSCD, capture-day-disjoint test)
tables.note: Official RSCD split, same EfficientNet multi-head recipe: 27-class acc 82.2%, friction 93.3%. 84% of official test images share their capture second with a training image, so the day-disjoint numbers are the honest estimate.

tables.title: Scene pipeline (GTSDB test, never used to train SignNet)
tables.note: Test split: 54 scenes, 82 signs (small; val numbers shown for stability).

tables.title: Road damage from the dashcam (RDD2022, held-out frames from 6 countries)
tables.note: F1 at the validation-chosen threshold 0.74: precision 62.2%, recall 55.8%. By country: Japan 0.59, India 0.45, Czech 0.46, Norway 0.45, United States 0.69, China MotorBike 0.79. On 54 unseen German frames it flags damage on 4 and reports no potholes.
